item.title: Trump Hires Team USA Goalie To Guard Southern Border
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — America's national security received a significant boost this week, as President Donald Trump announced that he had hired the goalie of the U.S. men's Olympic hockey team to guard the southern border.

item.title: Democrats Announce State Of The Union Response Will Be Delivered By Bad Bunny
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — The Democrat response to President Trump's State of the Union address will reportedly be delivered by Bad Bunny, sources confirmed Tuesday.

item.title: Trump Adds Take-A-Number Ticket Dispenser At Mar-A-Lago For Would-Be Assassins
item.description: PALM BEACH, FL — In an effort to create a more efficient process for everyone making an attempt on his life, President Donald Trump ordered his staff to install a "Take-A-Number" ticket dispenser at the front gate of Mar-a-Lago for all would-be assassins.

item.title: Man Scores Killer Discount On Flights To Puerto Vallarta
item.description: ATLANTA — Local man Brandon Haden reportedly wowed friends and family this week with a surprise trip to the exotic Mexican city of Puerto Vallarta, which he had purchased at a killer discount.

item.title: Thomas Massie To Hold His Own State Of The Union On Street Corner Outside A T.J. Maxx
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — According to sources, Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky will be holding his own State of the Union Address from a street corner outside a local T.J. Maxx.

item.title: Congress Confused By State Of Union From President Who Can Talk
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Congress stared in confusion this evening, puzzled by hearing a speech from a President who can say words and sentences.
